title: AgentPassport
description: Contrat-3 signed agent passport (.inspect_ia_agents/passport.json): a frozen, Ed25519-signed attestation that binds an agent identity to a mandate chain (delegation up to a human), a permitted action scope, and an expiry. This is the SIGNED artifact behind the discovery attestation axis (trusted/untrusted/unsigned/malformed), distinct from the unsigned .inspect_ia_agents/manifest.json (the passport_status axis). The shape is frozen: additionalProperties is false so no extra attestation data can ride past the signature boundary.
$comment: This schema enforces STRICTER STRUCTURAL pre-validation for committed corpus passports. The Rust agent-passport crate's Passport::from_json() parser is intentionally laxer (accepts any-string signature and spiffe_id, allows empty delegation) to give the verify() step -- which owns TRUST semantics (bad-hex signature => BadSignature, empty delegation => EmptyDelegation) -- the final say. A passport passing this schema may still be untrusted after verify(); a passport failing this schema is structurally malformed for corpus purposes.

id.description: Stable identifier of the agent this passport is issued to.

tenant.description: Tenant (governance boundary) the agent belongs to.

delegation.description: Mandate chain from the direct issuer outward, up to a human principal. A passport MUST delegate up to a human, so the chain is never empty (minItems 1); the terminal element is expected to be a human principal (e.g. human:...).

scope.description: Permitted action families (the capability scope) granted to the agent.

exp.description: Expiry as an RFC3339 date-time string (temporal validation is a verification concern, not a schema one).

spiffe_id.description: Optional SPIFFE identity (spiffe://...) bound to the agent.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the signed claims, hex-encoded: exactly 128 lowercase hex characters (64 bytes).

key_id.description: Identifier of the public key that verifies the signature.
